verdict.rationale: Expensify documents an Integration Server API with credential-based server-to-server integrations, which lets you automate tasks such as downloading report data and provisioning accounts without the UI. That counts as a first-party headless automation path. There is no evidence of a CLI, CI-specific guidance, or agent-oriented tooling, and the GitHub items only cover building the app itself. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI/CD integration docs or examples, machine-readable docs (the .md probe returned a 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
